name: Graphide
long_description:
Coding agents now write more code than teams can check, making verification pipelines the new bottleneck. Graphide builds that verification, starting with CI.

Graphide CI runs faster and cheaper because we own both the hardware and the optimizations and configs that run on it, which lets us do what owning only one could not. A graph of the codebase runs only the tests each change can reach, and always-on agents tune machines, caches and test splits together, around the clock. Optionally, we also patch the tests themselves with our own libraries so they run faster. We have seen most of our customers cut CI time 80-95% compared to their existing setups.

Our PR review agent then runs the old and new code in our live environments, finding bugs and proving them by writing tests, as well as analyzing synthetic and production data through the PR before it merges.

Finally, our visualizer allows you to see these data flows and graph based diffs to both easily analyze the found bugs, run custom data flows, and see / understand a PR in seconds.

Graphide's focus is on verifying the code agents write.
one_liner: CI 10-20× faster than GitHub runners, with a 24/7 agent optimizing it.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: CEO and co-founder of Graphide. Ran a software automation business in high school, then studied EECS and Business at UC Berkeley through the M.E.T. program. While at Illumio as an intern, built Matrix, the policy simulation platform Illumio uses today, orchestrating networks of 300+ VMs and simulating attacks across them. Left Berkeley to start Graphide.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Graphide. Founded and led the University of Cincinnati Linux and FOSS club, growing it to over 100 students. Previously ran tech operations for a political campaign, building custom voter outreach systems. Studying Computer Engineering and Mathematics at UC.
